R44BM.result: TWO_ACTIVATOR_SIBLING_SPLIT_MERGE exactly preserves maximum deficiency: delta*(M)=delta*(G).

R44BN.head: 783075165045d5d2057c70a247d9ad5482944418
R44BN.result: On the fixed R44AS critical parent, the exact existential projection on five remaining variables has auxiliary-free CNF clause complexity exactly 8; therefore every projection-faithful auxiliary-free CNF has delta*>=3 while parent rank is 2 and both sibling ranks are 1.
R44BN.effect: Strengthens R44AS from ordinary DP rebound to a representation-class lower bound for all auxiliary-free CNFs preserving the full projection function.

R44AS_rejoin.fact: R44AS already used a parent with delta*=2, every proper clause subset below 2, and both x2 cofactors at delta*=1; ordinary DP projection returns delta*=3.
R44AS_rejoin.meaning: RAW_DP_SIBLING_MERGE was already dead on a genuine branchwise-descending critical sibling instance.
